document.title: Form PENS.E/11 — Change of Country of Residence (for the two-track system only)

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/11 — Change of Country of Residence (for the two-track system only)
chunks.heading: What is Form PENS.E/11 used for?
chunks.text: Form PENS.E/11 notifies UNJSPF of a change in country of residence for a beneficiary paid under the two-track system.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/11 — Change of Country of Residence (for the two-track system only)
chunks.heading: What information is required in Sections 1 and 2?
chunks.text: Section 1 (Retiree or beneficiary information) requires UID, pension number, retirement number, full name, date of birth, and contact information. Section 2 (Change of country of residence) requires the former country of residence, new country of residence, full new address (PO Box and third-party/c/o addresses not accepted), and date of arrival in the new country.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/11 — Change of Country of Residence (for the two-track system only)
chunks.heading: What must be attached in Section 3 (Proof of Residence and Supporting Documents)?
chunks.text: A certificate of residence issued by a local government officer or the local police is required, and a change of payment options form (PF.23) may optionally be attached if changing payment instructions and/or currency. Proof of date of arrival must also be provided — such as a copy of the passport page with the immigration/customs stamp, a transportation ticket stub, a boarding pass, or other official document showing the date of arrival.

chunks.part: Form PENS.E/11 — Change of Country of Residence (for the two-track system only)
chunks.heading: What do I acknowledge and confirm by signing Section 4?
chunks.text: You confirm having read the form's instructions and that the information provided is true and correct.
